title: Network Of Beings
definition: The interconnectedness of all things, sustained by love and compassion.

difficulty_levels.beginner: Imagine a spider's web. Every string connects to every other. That's the network of beings.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: The mycelium network is an example of a complex system. It is sustained by mutualism and negative feedback loops.
difficulty_levels.expert: The network of beings is a philosophical concept from Eastern wisdom. It is connected to the holographic universe, the oneness of Brahman, and the unity of the self and the other.

extra_fields.insight: The network of beings is not separate from oneself. One is the network, experiencing itself from a particular node.
